title: Summer sublet needs a deposit now
scenario: A student says they are leaving for the summer and will sublet their room cheaply. They send a video tour and student ID photo but need a deposit tonight because “three exchange students are asking.”

answers.A: Verify the person, property and permission to sublet through the landlord/building or trusted university housing process before paying.
answers.B: Arrange a live video call showing the person at the property and verify the lease/sublet rules.
answers.C: Pay a smaller deposit because the student ID and video make the listing likely genuine.

explanation: IDs and property videos can be stolen from real listings. Payment should follow proof that the person controls the right to rent the space.
proTip: A room video proves the room exists, not that the sender can rent it to you.
